full_page.content:
1934, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 181 Cont.
March Mr. Ch's Lynch - 64 - away from Church over 26 yrs. - more than 25 yrs. lost to wife & Fam ... back now & practicing his faith ... ! !! Son has been taking fits ... no more now.
Maurice Bazinett - 46 - mastoid operation one in a thousand ... pul- led through ... now O.K .... but still out of work .. ...
Page 182 March 22nd Bernard Suscwitz - 14 - Epileptic about a year seemingly getting worse - Enrolled this a.m. for yr .... March 23 O.K. since enrolled to Holy Communion now every day.
Baby Rob. Gouchey - 5 mo. - injured at birth - Drs. want to oper- ate on skull when older ..... enrolled To-day ... Father non-C. prom- ises to look into religion if helpt.
F. Bucholtz - 55 - Lutheran, cancer of rectum - Wife believing - never baptized ...
23 David Cheadle - 5 - deaf & dumb from spinal maningitis at 17 months - otherwise seemingly a bright little boy. Enrolled To-day for yr.
24 Stella A. Mauer - trained nurse, obstruction in bowel, enemic, etc. To leave for Mao Brs .... Tomorrow. Enrolled again this P.M.
25 Thanksgiving Requested. (St. Joseph Hosp.) Beverly R. Kelsey - 2 - 5 feet of gangreenous bowel removed in 3 operations ...! O.K.now !!!
27 Frank Groth - 42 - frozen toe ... Dr's made arrangements to amputate toe on his 42nd birthday. His sister came and enrolled him in Ser. Mass A. Jan. 16 - 3 days before said operation. Dr's surprise .... black .. toes found O.K .... Deo Gr.
28 Eliz. Henrich - 57 - fears groth on head.
Mrs. Concetta S. - 39 - went to healler "Church of Christ" ...
Page 183 March 28 Mother Annunciata - superior - kidney trouble
Sister Catherine - St. John Berc. - gall.
Lungs & Heart Trouble! !! Theresa Schneid of Chicago - 23 - baby- sister of ten ... Operated on two years ago - collapsed lung. Dr's hoped for and promised much when operation was undertaken. Now further operation proposed, viz. to remove the ribs so as to make room for heart action.
29
